question: What 4-nitrophenol degradation efficiencies did the Ni–Ag/rGO catalyst reach in the first and in the tenth recycling run?
rendered: According to the document, the degradation efficiencies toward 4-nitrophenol (4-NP) in the first and tenth cycle experiments were 97.17% and 89.57%, respectively.
